question: Which of the following is NOT a domestic cricket tournament organised by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Super Fours**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Super Fours** is NOT a domestic cricket tournament organised by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).
 
• The domestic cricket tournaments organised by the BCCI include the **ZR Irani Cup**, **Vizzy Trophy**, and **Ranji Trophy**.
 
• The **ZR Irani Cup** is a first-class cricket tournament in India, named after Z. R. Irani.
 
• The **Vizzy Trophy** is a tournament for university cricket teams in India, named after Vizzy, the Maharajkumar of Vizianagram.
 
• The **Ranji Trophy** is a premier first-class cricket championship played in India, named after the famous cricketer, Ranjitsinhji.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **BCCI** is the national governing body for cricket in India, responsible for organizing various domestic and international cricket tournaments.
 
• Some other notable domestic cricket tournaments organized by the BCCI include the **Vijay Hazare Trophy**, **Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy**, and the **Duleep Trophy**.
 
• The BCCI was formed in December 1928 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
 
• The BCCI operates under the aegis of the International Cricket Council (ICC), the global governing body for cricket.
